typedef uint32_t (*cudartRegisterProfileDomain)(const char* domain_name, const char** function_list, uint32_t function_number);
typedef uint8_t (*cudartIsProfileCallbackEnabled)(uint32_t domain, uint32_t callback_id);
typedef void (*cudartProfileCallbackBegin)(uint32_t domain, uint32_t callback_id);
typedef void (*cudartProfileCallbackEnd)(uint32_t domain, uint32_t callback_id);

struct cudartProfileHandler {
    cudartRegisterProfileDomain registerProfileDomain;
    cudartIsProfileCallbackEnabled isCallbackEnabled;
    cudartProfileCallbackBegin profileCallbackBegin;
    cudartProfileCallbackEnd profileCallbackEnd;
};

static cudartProfileHandler g_profileHandler;
static bool gDirectReturn = false;
static const char* gLibName = "cudart";

static const char* getTgtLibraryName() {
  const char* pFile = NULL;

    const char* FakeLibraryName = "libfake_runtime.so";
    const char* LibraryName = "libhggcrt.12.0.so";

    if (strcmp(gLibName, "cuda") == 0) {
        LibraryName = "libhggc.so";
        FakeLibraryName = "libfake_driver.so";
    }

    const char* selector = getenv("HGGC_DRIVER_CANDIDATE");
    if (selector && (strcmp(selector, "FAKE") == 0)) {
          pFile = FakeLibraryName;
          void* handle = dlopen(pFile, RTLD_LAZY);
          if (handle) {
              dlclose(handle);
          } else {
              pFile = "libfake_driver.so";
          }
    } else if (selector && (strcmp(selector, "UMD") == 0)) {
        pFile = LibraryName;
    } else {
        pFile = LibraryName;
    }

  return pFile;
}

static void InitializeProfileHandler() {
    // get library patch
    const char* profile_tool_library = getenv("WRAPPER_INJECTION_PATH");
    if (profile_tool_library == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    // open profile library
    void* tool_handler = dlopen(profile_tool_library, RTLD_LAZY);
    if (!tool_handler) {
        printf("cannot open the file:%s  with error %s\n", profile_tool_library, dlerror());
        return;
    }

    // init profile handler
    g_profileHandler.registerProfileDomain = reinterpret_cast<cudartRegisterProfileDomain>(dlsym(tool_handler, "wrapperRegisterProfileDomain"));
    g_profileHandler.isCallbackEnabled = reinterpret_cast<cudartIsProfileCallbackEnabled>(dlsym(tool_handler, "wrapperIsProfileCallbackEnabled"));
    g_profileHandler.profileCallbackBegin = reinterpret_cast<cudartProfileCallbackBegin>(dlsym(tool_handler, "wrapperProfileCallbackBegin"));
    g_profileHandler.profileCallbackEnd = reinterpret_cast<cudartProfileCallbackEnd>(dlsym(tool_handler, "wrapperProfileCallbackEnd"));

    // register profile domain
    if (g_profileHandler.registerProfileDomain != NULL) {
        g_profileDomain = g_profileHandler.registerProfileDomain(gLibName, g_profileFunctionList, sizeof(g_profileFunctionList) / sizeof(g_profileFunctionList[0]));
        if (g_profileDomain == 0) {
            g_profileHandler.isCallbackEnabled = NULL;
        }
    }
}
